mapper.sql: id, quiz_id AS quizId, type, stem, points, position, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_question (quiz_id, type, stem, points, position, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{quizId}, #{type}, #{stem}, #{points}, #{position}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM quiz_question WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId} ORDER BY position
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_question SET position = #{position}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), 0) FROM quiz_question WHERE quiz_id = #{quizId}
